### Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.
A clear and concise description of the problem (e.g. "I'm always frustrated when...").

### Describe the Solution You'd Like
A clear description of what you want to happen (e.g. "Support for Apple Magic Trackpad 2 multi-touch gestures...").

### Describe Alternatives You've Considered
Any alternative solutions or features you've evaluated.

### Additional Context
Add any other context, hardware model numbers (e.g. A1644, A1535), or screenshots here.
